summary: Mid-market enterprise search vendor evaluating Redwood for production RAG. Primary driver: scale embeddings + reranking pipeline (30M docs index), predictable p95 latency under 300ms, and aggressive cost targets per query. Interested in dedicated capacity for consistent throughput and VPC controls for residency.
notes: Initial discovery 2025-10: product team built in-house vectordb; running into operational pain at scale. Currently evaluating trade-offs: managed DB like Pinecone vs self-hosted Weaviate/pgvector. Key quote from Head of Search: "We need reranking latency predictable — spikes kill rankings and UX." Security wants audit trails and KMS integration. Short, pragmatic purchase process: POC -> sec review -> procurement. Priorities: 1) Reranking latency 2) Cost/unit 3) Connector reliability.

technical_requirements: Throughput targets: 150-400 QPS typical, spikes to 1k QPS during peak
Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms end-to-end for query+rerank (including vector DB hop)
Cost target: average cost per query (embed + retrieval + model rerank) < $0.01
Reranking flow: retrieve top-K vector candidates (K=50), lightweight neural reranker (model size medium) for final sort
Hybrid search: BM25 pre-filtering then vector similarity + rerank
Filters: metadata filtering on tenant_id, region, document_type with low-cardinality facets
Consistency: near-real-time upserts (sub-second for hot docs), bulk backfills tolerated overnight
Security: VPC peering, SSO/SAML, KMS key wrapping for model logs, audit events to SIEM
integration_requirements: Connector must support bulk upsert (+ per-doc metadata) and incremental upserts
Namespace isolation (multi-tenant indices per customer) and per-namespace ACLs
Support for HNSW and configurable ANN params (ef, m) to tune latency/recall
Ability to run hybrid queries (BM25 + vector) or return BM25 scores alongside vector distances
Observability hooks: per-query latency, vector DB cost meter, cache hit ratio
Backpressure handling: graceful fallback to smaller model or cached responses
Compatibility: pgvector SQL interface desirable for batch jobs; managed connectors for Pinecone/Weaviate preferred
Resiliency: automatic retry with idempotent upserts and clear error taxonomy for partial failures
poC_plan: Week 0: Access + token exchange, network setup (VPC peering proof-of-concept)
Week 1: Ingest 3M docs sample (subset of production), run baseline retrieval against pgvector and Weaviate via Redwood connector
Week 2: Reranker integration test (run small-medium model on Dedicated) and measure p95 latency; enable KV caching and continuous batching
Week 3: Cost modeling: simulate 30M index steady-state; show cost/Q and ops playbook
Deliverable: decision brief with p95 latency numbers, cost/Q estimates, and connector maturity notes
product_fit: Dedicated capacity aligns with need for predictable latency & throughput
Smart routing + fallback good for multi-cloud ingestion and regional failover
Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) directly map to their cost targets
Observability features satisfy security team requirement for per-route tracing and audit logs
